delta: The trip of the trunk corridor feeding the Central Zone leaves the central demand center islanded from southern generation, forcing a choice between leveraging northern battery reserves and corridor thermal ratings to reduce costs, or contracting expensive industrial demand curtailment to minimize line stress.

diagnosis_es: Outage along the trunk corridor between the Central Zone and Centro-Sur causes overloading on northern transmission lines and extensive customer disconnections across the capital metropolitan area.

options.title_es: Northern Battery Storage and Corridor Dynamic Rating
options.rationale_es: Restores service to every affected household immediately while reducing overall operational expenses and emissions through northern battery storage and dynamic corridor transfer.

options.title_es: Metropolitan Demand Response and Thermal Uprate
options.rationale_es: Eliminates domestic unserved energy immediately while maintaining the lowest corridor loading by relying on contracted metropolitan industrial demand response at substantial expense.
